title: 三运放仪表放大器
statement: 三运放仪表放大器（instrumentation amplifier）：u_1 = 1.0 V，u_2 = 1.2 V；第一级 R_a = R_b = 20 kΩ，R_g = 10 kΩ；第二级 R_3 = R_5 = 10 kΩ，R_f = R_6 = 20 kΩ。运放均为理想运放。
求 R_g 中的电流 i_g（参考方向见图）、第一级输出 u_o1、u_o2 和最终输出 u_o。

questions.explain: 虚断：R_a、R_g、R_b 中是同一个电流 i_g。u_o1 = u_a + R_a·i_g = 1.0 + 20k × (−0.02 mA) = 0.6 V。
第二级是减法器（R_6/R_5 = R_f/R_3 = 2）：u_o = 2(u_o2 − u_o1) = 2 V。总差模放大倍数 5 × 2 = 10。

hints: 先看第一级：A_1、A_2 的虚短把 u_1、u_2 直接“搬”到 R_g 两端。
A_1、A_2 的反相端不取电流，所以 R_a、R_g、R_b 串联、电流相同；第二级是熟悉的减法器。
solution: **2. 虚断：** i_g = (u_a − u_b)/R_g = **−0.02 mA**，这个电流同样流过 R_a（o1 → a）和 R_b（b → o2）。
**总结：** u_o = (R_f/R_3)(1 + 2R_a/R_g)(u_2 − u_1) = 10 × 0.2 = 2 V。两个输入都接同相端，输入电阻为无穷大；只需改变一个电阻 R_g 就能调节放大倍数。

en.title: Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier
statement: A three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier: u_1 = 1.0 V, u_2 = 1.2 V; first stage R_a = R_b = 20 kΩ, R_g = 10 kΩ; second stage R_3 = R_5 = 10 kΩ, R_f = R_6 = 20 kΩ. All op-amps are ideal.
Find the current i_g in R_g (reference as drawn), the first-stage outputs u_o1 and u_o2, and the final output u_o.

questions.explain: Virtual short: u_a = u_1 = 1.0 V, u_b = u_2 = 1.2 V. i_g = (u_a − u_b)/R_g = −0.2/10k = −0.02 mA.
Virtual open: R_a, R_g and R_b carry the same current i_g. u_o1 = u_a + R_a·i_g = 1.0 + 20k × (−0.02 mA) = 0.6 V.
u_o2 = u_b − R_b·i_g = 1.2 + 0.4 = 1.6 V. The differential voltage is amplified by (1 + 2R_a/R_g) = 5: u_o2 − u_o1 = 5 × 0.2 = 1.0 V.
The second stage is a subtractor (R_6/R_5 = R_f/R_3 = 2): u_o = 2(u_o2 − u_o1) = 2 V. Overall differential gain 5 × 2 = 10.

hints: Start with the first stage: the virtual shorts of A_1 and A_2 copy u_1 and u_2 straight onto the two ends of R_g.
The inverting inputs of A_1 and A_2 draw no current, so R_a, R_g and R_b are in series with the same current; the second stage is the familiar subtractor.
solution: **1. Virtual short:** u_a = u_1 = 1.0 V, u_b = u_2 = 1.2 V, so the voltage across R_g is the input difference u_1 − u_2 = −0.2 V.
**2. Virtual open:** i_g = (u_a − u_b)/R_g = **−0.02 mA**, and the same current flows through R_a (o1 → a) and R_b (b → o2).
**3. First-stage outputs:** u_o1 = u_a + R_a·i_g = **0.6 V**, u_o2 = u_b − R_b·i_g = **1.6 V**.
u_o2 − u_o1 = (1 + 2R_a/R_g)(u_2 − u_1) = 5 × 0.2 = 1.0 V, while the common-mode part (u_o1 + u_o2)/2 = 1.1 V = (u_1 + u_2)/2 is not amplified.
**Summary:** u_o = (R_f/R_3)(1 + 2R_a/R_g)(u_2 − u_1) = 10 × 0.2 = 2 V. Both inputs go to non-inverting inputs, so the input resistance is infinite, and the gain is set by the single resistor R_g.
